About MineIQ

Uncover safe squares by reasoning from numbered clues. MineIQ brings the familiar Minesweeper challenge into the IQ Games collection. Each revealed number tells you how many mines are in the surrounding squares, including diagonals.

How to play

  1. Reveal squares and examine the numbered clues.
  2. Use neighboring clues together to work out which squares may contain mines.
  3. Uncover the safe squares while avoiding the mines.
